title: Do Not Call Lists: Never Call a Number You Must Not Call | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
A call to a number on a do-not-call list can cost far more than it earns, and no agent can check a purchased list by hand. CrestApps for Orchard Core keeps your own lists and the national registries in one place and checks them when contacts are imported and before the dialer places a call.

In this video:
• Why do-not-call lists matter, and where they are checked
• Uploading a local list by country, and preparing the CSV file
• Following and managing lists: status, errors and the Actions menu
• Making every import check the lists you choose
• What people see on the import screen
• Connecting the USA FTC and Canada LNNTE-DNCL registries
• Use cases for suppression lists, purchased leads and monthly downloads

chapters.title: What people see when they import
